title: Daughter of Zion! from the Dust
description: Daughter of Zion! from the Dust in Tonic Solfa to CAITHNESS, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 179, “Daughter of Zion”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to CAITHNESS; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Daugh-ter of Zi-on! from the dust Ex-alt thy fall-en head; A-gain in thy Re-deem-er trust, He calls thee from the dead.

lines: Daughter of Zion! from the dust
He calls thee from the dead.
Awake, awake! put on thy strength,
The day of freedom dawns at length,
Rebuild thy walls, thy bounds enlarge,
Say to the south, "Give up thy charge,
And keep not back, O north!"
They come, they come; — thine exiled bands,
Have heard thy voice in distant lands,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: James Montgomery died in 1854.
credits: Words by James Montgomery (1771–1854), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to CAITHNESS by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
